mission.title: The Night Desk
mission.objective: Get the prototype out of the lab before the hired crew reaches it
mission.exitCondition: Leave by the service lift or the east stair with the prototype before the alarm reaches Lockdown
mission.briefing: Meridian on Wilshire, Westlake, a 2017 tower with smart-era security: badge plus PIN on the locked doors, five IP cameras with analytics in the halls, four guards on tight rounds. Someone on the night desk has sold the prototype, and tonight's guards will hand it to a hired crew. Suite 2401 on floor 24 is vacant and dark; the prototype lab opens off the north hall. Get it out first: up the service lift from the loading dock, keep out of the halls, open the lab, and leave by the service lift or the east stair. Nobody gets hurt. The mission is fictional, and the security here is game fiction, drawn from the building's class and era.
